name: Nitin Spinners Ltd
title: Nitin Spinners Ltd - 532698 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Yarn spread up to ~INR120-125/kg from ~INR110 with spinning at 98%+ utilisation and ~INR1,100 crore capex (fabric +35m m, spinning +22k t) commissioning H2 FY27 — supply adds ahead, demand and spreads firm.

utilisation.quote: spinning capacity was operating at over 98% utilization and woven fabric capacity was operating at over 90% utilization

capex.peers_comment: Management said some domestic capacity has gone out from obsolescence and lack of working capital, and few new entrants expected.
capex.quote: I don't expect that majority of the capacity, which had very small economic sense will come back

triggers.label: Spinning utilisation over 98%
triggers.quote: spinning capacity was operating at over 98% utilization

triggers.label: Domestic capacity exits, unlikely to return
triggers.quote: Some of these capacities have gone out because of obsolescence, because of lack of working capital

triggers.label: Yarn spread INR110 → INR120-125/kg
triggers.quote: The last quarter spreads were about INR110 a kg and now it is about INR125

triggers.label: New capacity adds ~INR1,100 crore, H2 FY27
triggers.quote: we'll add another 35 million meters to 70 (Errata: Actual Number to be read as 75) million meters annually and spinning capacity by another 22,000 tons

guidance.quote: our normal margin should be in the range of 16% to 20%. We expect that we should be able to maintain

guidance.metric: Revenue uplift from new capacity and yarn normalisation
guidance.quote: we should be -- from here onwards, we should be easily able to add 30% to 35% of our -- to our existing revenue numbers

guidance.value: INR50 crore per annum; INR30-35 crore this year
guidance.quote: we expect that we will have a saving of around INR30 crores to INR35 crores
our normal total debt, we are expecting to be less than -- in the range of about INR1,900 crores to INR2,000 crores

red_flags.label: Knitted fabric utilisation low, customers lost to competitors
red_flags.quote: we also lost some of the customers to other competing countries, which we are trying to make up

red_flags.label: Management declined to share inventory numbers
red_flags.quote: I'm sorry that I cannot share the numbers on the inventory side

evasions.quote: I'm sorry that I cannot share the numbers on the inventory side
At this point of time, I will not be able to comment on the future capex
we are not targeting any margins. And specifically, we do not give any numbers for the fabric margins
